content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(list-partial(@F, @G), Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real)), Analysis.higherInfinitesimal(F, G, x), Logic.and(Analysis.infinitesimal(F, x), Logic.and(Analysis.infinitesimal(G, x), Analysis.funLim(Div.div(F, G), @y, x, $0$))))
content.markdown: `F = o(G)` at `x₀` iff both are infinitesimals there and `F/G` tends to `0`; `F` vanishes strictly faster than `G`. This is the relation in which the Peano form of Taylor's remainder is stated: the remainder is `o((x − x₀)ᴺ)`.
